blocks.text: After adding an application and configuring its probes, you can edit any probe details that are not preconfigured.
You cannot reconfigure preset probe configurations. To learn more about configuring probes, see Configuring a Probe.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Digital Experience > Settings & Configurations > Probes > <collection name> > <application name>.
Under the Actions column, click the Kebab icon (3 vertical dots), and then click Edit.
In the Edit Probe window, configure the fields as needed. To learn more about the fields, see Configuring a Probe.
Some fields cannot be edited due to the nature of the previously selected probe configuration.
Submit your settings on the Review tab.

blocks.text: Zscaler recommends waiting at least 30 minutes after editing probe settings to begin seeing changes in the dashboard.
